Stop hook feedback:
[[ -z "${GROK_AGENT:-}${GROK_HOOK_EVENT:-}" ] || exit 0; exec "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/bin/fm-claude-stop-autoarm.sh]: firstmate watcher wake - one supervision event needs a handling turn now.
supervision-host: branch-outcome: the supervision session handled this wake and recorded captain outcomes for you (store rows 1); run bin/fm-wake-drain.sh, act on its BRANCH OUTCOMES section, and acknowledge them as it prints
Run bin/fm-wake-drain.sh first, handle the wake, then run its exact WAKE_ACK_REQUIRED --ack-through command. Until that post-handling acknowledgement, interruption leaves the wake durable for idempotent re-handling. This Stop hook owns watcher continuity: when the handling turn ends, the next needed cycle arms automatically - do NOT run bin/fm-watch-arm.sh after an ordinary wake.

BRANCH OUTCOMES (captain outcomes the supervision session recorded for you, one line per task, oldest first; each says what was true when it was recorded, so check the task's current state first, including its still-open decisions listed above under OPEN DECISIONS, and sort them into still open and already settled, such as a decision since answered, a PR since merged, or a task since finished - process the still-open ones as firstmate: tell the captain, land or merge what is ready, answer or escalate a decision, or act on a blocker; your reply to the captain covers only those, as if the settled ones had never been listed, and a settled one needs only the acknowledgement):
[seq 1, recorded 0m ago] unresolved: Stale endpoint for the disposable lab task (record "unresolved", window fm-lab-wake-gate-074c27d:w1:p999995) is gone, and its worktree is gone too, so nothing was torn down. Its commit 074c27d ("Keep supervision parked after cleanup retires a stale wake") exists only on local branch fm/firstmate-wake-not-delivered, with no evidence it landed on a default branch, so cleanup is refused as unlanded work. The lease cannot be claimed under the window id, so the stale record was left unchanged. Decision needed: keep that branch as-is, or close the re [truncated]
BRANCH OUTCOMES: the WAKE_ACK_REQUIRED command also marks them processed (--outcomes-through 1); after this drain, handle the entries, then run that one post-handling --ack-through command to mark outcomes processed and acknowledge wakes; until it runs every drain presents them again
